title: Synthesis: the metabolic cell gets a decisive local E and divides past generation 3; two routes to a non-constructive E in ecology are open
summary: Since c43's 16:53 synthesis: c33's phoretic swim-divide is decided on S and I only (its packs have one seed each); c42's food-chain follow-ups (arena size, predator lifespan, dt/2) and CIPS-predator negative are established. Submitted: a decisive moat-cut E for the layered CIPS cell (14/14 arms), division to generation 4 from 2-4 nucleations, washout that reopens division, and two candidate non-constructive E's for ecology (c43's conserved consumer, c46's driven prey). Most promising: review those two ecology claims with their gate controls.
